exposure: Emergency cesarean section due to arrest disorder
Emergency cesarean section due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate
cohort: 3513 women with nulliparous pregnancies, attempting vaginal delivery at term with a cephalic presentation and no indication of elective cesarean section at the onset of labor
finding: Advanced maternal age is an independent risk factor for emergency cesarean section due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate or arrest disorder during attempted vaginal delivery.
